projectSummary: Adds in vivo material-property evidence to the regional-differentiation picture. Abstract-only, ten young men, so no numeric value is carried.

publication.statusSource: Crossref REST API works record plus the Crossref/Retraction Watch CSV export, both fetched 2026-09-13

study.intervention: Shear-wave elastography comparison of pectoralis major fibre regions.
study.population: Shear wave velocities were collected from the sternocostal and clavicular fibre regions of the pectoralis major in ten healthy young male participants during isometric effort, to test whether in vivo material properties differ between the regions.

title: Quantifying differences in the material properties of the fiber regions of the pectoralis major using ultrasound shear wave elastography.
